'''Heptooine''' was a planet located in the south quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Kymoodon Era]], areas of space grew around Heptooine, as well as [[Aplooine]], [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] and [[Sestooine]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Heptooine was considered one of the oldest relics of colonization into the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. For millennia, it existed as a frontier outpost until a sizable population grew into the surrounding regions of the sector. By the time of Sith control, it had reverted to barbarism after several decades of famine and war.<ref name="KEG" />
